changes.purpose: Analyze only SHA-256-validated native temporal 100% crops and rank adjacent-frame transitions using luminance histogram, edge/high-frequency energy and small translation-compensated luma error.
Machine-readable non-scoring policy: manual review required, zero automatic Visual Fidelity points, and no automatic clearing of severe aliasing/shimmering or visible LOD pop.
Validate the diagnostics contract before render work and analyze the sealed temporal evidence immediately after native-4K temporal capture.

notes: The diagnostic analyzer first invokes ValidateLatestTemporalEvidence, so missing, altered, unsealed, wrong-size or non-pixel-exact temporal evidence is rejected before metrics are generated.
Metrics are advisory triage only: low values never clear severe_aliasing_or_shimmer or visible_lod_pop, while high values create manual review candidates rather than an automatic visual FAIL.
The Native 4K Review Packet now validates this policy before synchronized capture and runs diagnostics only after the required sealed subpixel_grazing and lod_walk_oblique sequences exist.
No runtime screenshots, Unity compile artifact or Captures4K/Temporal4K evidence was available during this source-side run.

expectedVisualScoreImpact: Temporal/LOD/aliasing stability: once a runner exists, exact frame pairs with abnormal high-frequency or transition-statistic changes are surfaced first for 100%-pixel review, reducing time to locate real shimmer and LOD discontinuities.

Critical severe aliasing/shimmering and visible LOD pop: the new path strengthens evidence triage but deliberately cannot clear or assert either critical defect without human inspection of the sealed native frames.
Evidence integrity: diagnostics are bound to the already validated native temporal manifest/crops and cannot silently substitute resampled or unsealed proxy images for review.
Real-time quality iteration: ranked transition pairs should make subsequent corrective work target the largest observed temporal deduction instead of speculative scene expansion.
nextBlocker: Unity 6000.3.0f1 editor/runner compile and native 3840x2160 execution. At first availability, run Prepare Complete Native 4K Review Packet; inspect all ranked temporal candidates and the full sequences at 100% before scoring, then fix the largest actual deduction or any critical defect instead of adding speculative detail.
